skala_align_multiline_comments #

Align multiline constructs — Align multiline comments with asterisks. Implemented at the export's true, where Skala reproduces the oracle byte for byte: every continuation line of a qualifying block comment lands on the opening /*'s column plus one, the closing */'s line included. ⚠ The qualifying shape is narrower than 'a comment whose lines begin with *' — every continuation line must, and an empty or whitespace-only line among them disqualifies the comment, measured. ⚠ Registered OfUnoracled, because at false the oracle freezes a starred comment entire including the column its /* is written at, and Skala re-indents that at both values — honoured, observable, not conformant at one of two values. SK-DIV-0033.

skala_alignment_tab_fill_style #

Align multiline constructs — How to align when tabs are used for indents. Implemented: LayoutWriter.WriteIndentTo writes all three layouts and TabFillStyleTests pins each against the oracle's own bytes under indent_style = tab. use_spaces — the export's value — tabs to the line's level column and spells the alignment remainder in spaces; use_tabs_only rounds to the nearest tab stop, ties downwards, and writes no spaces at all; optimal_fill divides the whole column by the tab width. Registered OfInert rather than Of, and the reason is the corpus and not the key: every committed fixture is space-indented, at which all three values spell the identical column, so no oracle glob is possible and the key-flip sweep cannot reach it. It becomes Tier A when the corpus can carry a per-directory .editorconfig (SK-DIV-0032).

Typeone of use_spaces, use_tabs_only, optimal_fill

skala_allow_far_alignment #

Align multiline constructs — Align even if the resulting indentation is too large ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified masked. ⚠ Not inert — the `OfInert` registration at PhaseOneOptions.cs ~1779 is overturned. On an invocation whose callee name pushes the argument column to about 98, with the export's resharper_csharp_align_multiline_argument = true, skala_wrap_after_invocation_lpar = false and skala_wrap_arguments_style = chop_always, the oracle gives two distinct layouts: at true the arguments align to the far lpar column, at false they fall back to one continuation level. The export sets align_multiline_argument = false and skala_wrap_after_invocation_lpar = true, so at the standard's own configuration there is no alignment column for this key to allow or refuse. Masked, not inert; Skala is flat at both values, so a glob would report INERT.

skala_outdent_binary_ops #

Align multiline constructs — Outdent binary operators. A wrapped operator moves left by its own width plus the space written after it — + from column 12 to 10, && from 12 to 9 — so that the operand behind it keeps the column it would have had. Implemented by the IndentKind.OutdentColumns scope the earlier note said the IR did not have.

skala_outdent_dots #

Align multiline constructs — Outdent dots in chained method calls. A wrapped . moves from column 12 to 11 — one column and not two, because space_after_dot = false leaves the dot no space to account for. Implemented by IndentKind.OutdentColumns, which asks SpaceRules for that space rather than assuming it.
